Veterans Benefits: California partially excludes qualifying military retirement and Survivor Benefit Plan income—up to $20,000 for tax years 2025–2029, subject to federal AGI limits of $125,000 ($250,000 for joint filers and qualifying surviving spouses). Veterans rated 100% disabled for a service-connected disability or compensated at the 100% rate due to individual unemployability may qualify for an assessed-value exemption on a principal residence; it is not generally a complete property-tax waiver. Additional programs include dependent college fee waivers, qualifying disabled-veteran vehicle fee exemptions, and CalVet home loans.
Description: Fresno is a major city in California's San Joaquin Valley with a hot semi-arid climate and proximity to Yosemite National Park. It offers more affordable housing than coastal California, though it shares the state's high tax burden.
